# Find and replace text

Replace a word or phrase across one slide or the whole deck, keeping formatting.

## Inputs

Take these from the user's request (ask if a required one is missing):

- `<find>` (required): The text to find.
- `<replace>` (required): The replacement text.
- `<scope>`: "deck" (default) or a slide reference. Default: deck.

Replace "<find>" with "<replace>" (scope: <scope>).

1. Decide whether every occurrence should change. Read the slides in scope
   with `query_slide` when the phrase could also mean something else (a
   brand name, a quotation) or appears inside longer words.
2. When all of them should change, call `text_replace` once — whole deck,
   or `slide` for one slide, `objects` for particular boxes. It covers text
   boxes and table cells and keeps the formatting of the text it replaces.
   Use `matchCase: false` for a case-insensitive match and `wholeWord: true`
   so "cat" does not hit "concatenate".
3. When only some should change, change those with `text_edit` at their
   offsets (from `query_object`; a paragraph break "\n\n" counts 2), several
   in one `ops_apply` so the whole replacement is one step to revert.
4. Report how many occurrences you replaced on which slides (`text_replace`
   returns them), and any you skipped on purpose.
